Print selected rows once

Source: R/special-print.R
special-print.Rd

Display selected rows in the console without storing print preferences.

  • print_headtail(): Print the first and last rows.

  • print_interval(): Print evenly spaced rows.

Usage

print_headtail(
  .data,
  n = 10,
  width = NULL,
  ...,
  max_extra_cols = NULL,
  max_footer_lines = NULL
)

print_interval(
  .data,
  n = 10,
  width = NULL,
  ...,
  max_extra_cols = NULL,
  max_footer_lines = NULL
)

Arguments

.data

An in-memory data frame, data.table, ordinary/grouped/rowwise tibble, or sf data frame. Collect lazy tables and convert other subclasses explicitly first. Apply previews separately to lists of tables.

n

Total number of data rows to display, defaulting to 10. Supply a positive whole number or Inf for all rows; omission markers do not count.

width

Console width passed to tibble formatting. NULL (default) uses the current console width; Inf shows every column.

...

Additional arguments passed to tibble formatting.

max_extra_cols, max_footer_lines

Maximum number of additional columns to describe and footer lines to print, respectively. NULL uses tibble's defaults.

Value

.data, unchanged and invisibly, including all rows, columns, classes, grouping, and any existing preview preferences.

Details

Each call prints a temporary preview and returns the complete original table. Existing groups share one row budget; they are not printed separately.

Row budgets and omission markers follow preview(): head/tail output marks an omitted middle with one row of dots; interval output has no separator rows. Use n = Inf and width = Inf to print every row and column.

See also

preview() for persistent print preferences.

Examples

print_headtail(lifeexp, n = 6)
#> # A tibble: 68 × 6
#>    region               country       popgrowth  lexp gnppc safewater
#>    <dbl+lbl>            <chr>             <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>     <dbl>
#>  1 1 [Europe & C. Asia] Albania            -0.6    74   870        49
#>  2 1 [Europe & C. Asia] Armenia            -1.2    70   570        83
#>  3 1 [Europe & C. Asia] Austria             0.1    78 27810        97
#>  ⋮ ⋮                          ⋮              ⋮      ⋮     ⋮         ⋮
#> 66 3 [South America]    Peru                1.8    69  2150        45
#> 67 3 [South America]    Uruguay             0.5    74  7360        NA
#> 68 3 [South America]    Venezuela, RB       2      72  3380        NA
#> # ... 62 rows omitted in the middle; use print(x, n = Inf) to show all rows.

print_interval(lifeexp, n = 6)
#> # A tibble: 68 × 6
#>    region               country       popgrowth  lexp gnppc safewater
#>    <dbl+lbl>            <chr>             <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>     <dbl>
#>  1 1 [Europe & C. Asia] Albania            -0.6    74   870        49
#> 14 1 [Europe & C. Asia] France              0.4    79 25740        97
#> 28 1 [Europe & C. Asia] Norway              0.6    78 36120       100
#> 41 1 [Europe & C. Asia] Ukraine            -0.8    68   840        66
#> 55 2 [North America]    Panama              2      73  3510        NA
#> 68 3 [South America]    Venezuela, RB       2      72  3380        NA
#> # ... 62 rows omitted between displayed positions; use print(x, n = Inf) to
#> # show all rows.
